policy: Read-only research conversions. Assumptions travel with values; no XDF export is enabled.

yamaha_temperature_candidate.status: inferred conditional profile; ECU identity and analog circuit unconfirmed
yamaha_temperature_candidate.basis: Both digital curves admit a constant ratiometric NTC pullup across XT660 resistance specifications. TDM900 fail-safe values match both fallback codes under this formula.
yamaha_temperature_candidate.conflict: XT660 2004 manual specifies coolant fail-safe 80 C; this formula gives 60 C. TDM900 specifies 60 C. This does not identify this dump as TDM900 firmware or prove its board matches either manual.
requires: NTC to ground with constant pullup to ADC reference
sensor specifications apply to this ECU

nominal_xt_timer.status: service-correlated nominal; not measured on this ECU
nominal_xt_timer.basis: TSCR2=5 gives bus/32. Fan diagnostic repeats every 250 tasks; each task is 4*2500 timer ticks. Yamaha specifies a 5-second fan cycle with 2 seconds on, 3 off.

nominal_xt_crank.status: conditional: 11 capture intervals including one double interval interpreted as one crank revolution
nominal_xt_crank.basis: Counter wraps at 11; gap interval is halved; A44 sums six normalized pitches; A36 contains three. Rotor-to-crank and TDC phase require independent confirmation.

temperature_celsius_candidate.meaning: Inferred temperature profile; consistent with sensor resistances and TDM fallback values, but XT660 manual coolant fallback differs. See TEMPERATURE_PROFILE.md.

dwell_ms.meaning: base dwell contribution; additional dwell and speed clamps still apply

injector_compensation_ms.meaning: additive injector-duration compensation after lookup rounding

speed_rpm.meaning: ideal speed-coordinate scale; reciprocal truncation, saturation and stale-state handling are separate

spark_relative_degrees.meaning: relative scheduler angle, NOT absolute degrees BTDC; fixed and variable timer corrections follow

q8_gain_percent.meaning: dimensionless multiplier of the stated contribution, not necessarily total fuel

fuel_iat_gain_percent.meaning: IAT factor in the normal fuel chain; integer rounding occurs in the actual multi-stage calculation

transient_iat_gain_percent.meaning: factor in transient contribution; not the same scaling as normal IAT correction

normalization_gain_percent.meaning: multiplicative factor in the denominator, not a direct fuel multiplier

gain128_percent.meaning: 128 represents unity in the normalized consumer equation; exact integer stages and saturation are in map_models.py.

startup_base_ms.meaning: Startup base with neutral reference multipliers. Interpolation retains Q8; speed, throttle, IAT and pressure factors follow.

post_start_enrichment_pp.meaning: Contribution of the selected post-start state high byte before remaining gains. States decay and their maximum is selected; they are not added.

coolant_enrichment_pp.meaning: Additive coolant contribution to the normalized pre-gain, before IAT, pressure, transient and other multipliers. Zero contribution at cell zero.

adaptive_step_pp.unit: normalized fuel percentage points per transition step
adaptive_step_pp.meaning: Magnitude of a transition-triggered adjustment to centered RAM 0x097E. Not a bound or percentage applied on every scheduler tick.

transient_delta_slope_pp.unit: normalized fuel percentage points per raw delta count
transient_delta_slope_pp.meaning: Slope before the sign-dependent coolant factor and downstream gains. Delta source is an internal code, not degrees/second or kPa/second.

load_offset_codes.meaning: Additive offset into CB4 relative to CB2, saturated to a word. It is not a pressure multiplier or measured kPa.

normalization_offset_codes.meaning: Latched into CD4 under eligibility gates, added to the selected normalization code before its inverse-ratio calculation.

feedback_delay_s.meaning: Threshold in a saturating counter incremented by the 200-base-tick task; reset in startup state. Nominal one second per count.

feedback_delay_100ms_s.meaning: Threshold in a saturating counter incremented by the 20-base-tick task; reset in startup state. Nominal 0.1 second per count.

normalization_hold_s.meaning: Latched threshold for qualifying 2-base-tick task iterations before correction recovery. Conditional count, not an unconditional wall-clock timer.

relative_tps_counts.unit: 10-bit ADC counts above learned closed position
relative_tps_counts.meaning: Threshold compared with min(255,filtered relative TPS count). Electrical/mechanical angle remains unconfirmed.

eligibility.meaning: Zero inhibits this gate; any nonzero byte passes this gate. Other conditions can still inhibit the function.

injection_event_code.meaning: Target used by injection scheduling, cyclic modulo 24 around D7E reference. After lookup 11 becomes 10 and >=23 becomes 22. Not absolute degrees BTDC or a duration.

temperature.status: explicit conditional profile; not verified hardware units
temperature.support: Quantization-aware resistance consistency test admits common pullups for both curves. TDM900 manual fallback 60/20 C matches raw144/80. Variant-selector tests leave both temperature conversions unchanged.
temperature.conflict: XT660 service manual specifies coolant fallback80 C. TDM evidence does not relabel this XT660X image. Dashboard offset and circuit values remain unverified.

supply.status: hypothesis; not assigned to map axes
supply.support: Would make fault replacement 154 approximately 12 V and dwell-axis knots approximately 6.5 to 16.5 V.
supply.conflict: Analog divider and dashboard decode are absent; diagnostic payload floor(raw*256/240) is not proven to be decivolts.

pressure.status: service-correlated hypothesis; not assigned to load axes
pressure.support: Assuming diagnostic payload units of 0.5 kPa agrees with approximately 3.6 V at atmospheric pressure on a 5 V ADC.
pressure.conflict: Dashboard scale and reference voltage unverified. C90 is a processed load coordinate, not direct manifold pressure.

throttle.status: service-correlated hypothesis; not assigned to map axes
throttle.support: ADC ten-bit count minus learned baseline is shifted left 6. Diagnostic angle ranges suggest ADC counts/8 degrees.
throttle.conflict: Dashboard conversion and mechanical sensor geometry unverified. Relative closed angle is not percent throttle.
